cohort_definition.G10_MONETARY_TRIADS: All three currencies in fixedG10 monetary/liquidity set; latent globally traded currency relations.
cohort_definition.MANAGED_EXTENSION_TRIADS: At least one nonG10 currency and every nonG10 currency in fixedDKK,SGD,CNH managed/peg set.
cohort_definition.OTHER_EXTENSION_TRIADS: Other completed extended currency relation, paid separately; no universal direction with other cohorts.
